blocks.x: If you have an upcoming trip to Mexico’s colorful, tourist-ready destinations of Cancún or Riviera Maya, don’t overlook Xcaret, a unique and fun natural water park. It's nearly impossible to be bored here—beyond the water activities, Xcaret is also an amusement park and eco-archaeological park (one at which biologists and naturalists take their work seriously; visitors can learn about the Mexican Caribbean’s cultural, environmental, and historical landscape here). For that reason, it’s an especially great place for families and first-time travelers to Mexico who have an itch to run and play, while experiencing a pretty decent overview of the country’s culture. Not to mention, Hotel Xcaret Mexico, which was named one of our readers’ favorite hotels in Mexico in 2021 and 2022, is on site and all-inclusive (and thanks to its versatility, it's been deemed an ideal all-inclusive for travelers who normally fear them).

Below, curated the top Xcaret coupon codes, offers and package deals so you can save a lot while living a little. Read on to find a handful of timely promo codes and value deals that’ll make these stellar experiences a bit more affordable.
Save 20% with this Xcaret discount codes, plus early bird discounts

Today, Xcaret is among one of the only water parks in the region, and the largest one at that, home to more than 50 natural and cultural attractions, from swimming and snorkeling in underground rivers to personalized, guided tours of Yucátan’s archaeological sites, like Chichen Itza, and cenotes like Tsukán. Lucky for you, Xcaret’s Viva Mexico sale includes 20% off of parks and tours when you use the promo code MEXICO26.

When planning ahead to visit, take advantage of advance purchase Xcaret deals to secure tickets at a lower price, ensuring your spot at one of the most popular eco-parks in Mexico. When purchasing tickets for select parks 7 to 20 days in advance, you can score 10% off—and when purchasing tickets 21 days in advance, you’ll save 15%. Plus, save 25% on your admissions (for children) to Xoximilco when you book on Mondays, Tuesdays, Wednesdays, and Thursdays.
Take an extra 20% off Xcaret packages

Daredevil travelers in search of a wild ride—at value—are in luck. Thanks to 20% off your purchase, you’ll automatically save when you build your own package of 2 up to 4 parks. Enjoy the ultimate ATV Xperience, parks, archaeological sites and save automatically, no promo code necessary. Xcaret guests can save on scenic and fun off-road drives through trails surrounded by the jungle in Cancún, ride to swim in crystal clear waters at Playa del Carmen, or along swirling trails to a cenote in Puerto Morelos.
Buy two park admissions, get one free with this Xcaret coupon code

Maximize your experience by booking an exclusive Xcaret resort package, in which travelers can enjoy bundled discounts on all sorts of experiences, from accommodations to park access. Known as the three-for-two sale, use discount code PAQ3XO24 to purchase a package of three park admissions for the price of two, with or without transportation. The deal can be applied to include Xcaret Plus, Xel-Há (an all-inclusive park offering more than 14 water and land activities, snorkeling, and unlimited food and beverages), Xenses (a relaxing half-day park with picturesque views, attractions, and more), Xoximilco (colorful trajinera, or traditional boat tour, that takes you through canals, and hosts heaps of music and dancing), and Xplor (adventure park with zip-lining and lush excursions through Riviera Maya).

Planning a family vacation? Xcaret has heaps of children’s activities for hours of fun, from waterslides to wading pools and sandboxes at Children’s World. Take advantage of the Xcaret kids promotion, where if you’re traveling with children between the ages of 5 to 11 years old, you can receive 25% off the price of adult tickets. Kids four and under enter for free. Even better, you can buy with confidence knowing that even without a coupon, Xcaret guarantees you’ll find the lowest rates when you book tours and park tickets directly through their online website. Even better, you can buy with confidence knowing that even without a coupon, Xcaret guarantees you’ll find the lowest rates when you book tours and park tickets directly through their online website.
Special Xcaret promo codes for HSBC credit card holders

If you’re an HSBC cardholder, you’re in luck. Thanks to Xcaret’s partnership promotion with HSBC, if you purchase your admissions to Xcaret Park in Riviera Maya with your HSBC credit card, use promo code HSBCXC to score a second park day of Basic Admission for free. If you purchase an Xcaret and Xplor package with code HSBCSC1, you’ll get free admission to Xoximilco as well. These tickets are valid for one year from the date of purchase, so you’ll have plenty of time to book your flights and plan your trip.
What to do if your Xcaret promo code is not working

If your Xcaret promo code isn't working at checkout, don't panic—there are a few things you can do. For starters, double check that your promo code is spelled correctly and that there are no extra spaces or typos. You should also check the terms and conditions of the promo code to ensure it's still active and hasn't expired. If everything looks good and your Xcaret promo code still isn't working, clear your browser's cache and give the page a refresh. When in doubt, contact Xcaret's customer service to help sort it out.
